draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.24, the 74th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 4th of 21 at S. He went 40th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (74th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Published comparison: Tedric Thompson. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: his final season (2020) ranked 2nd in tackles among the 21 Ss in his class with stats.
